mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0 and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth falls below -2% and remains below for at least one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index for three consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1 million units for three consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1,000 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase of at least 0.4 percentage points in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a monthly decline of at least 0.3% in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a significant labor market deterioration, which reduces earnings and consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% combined with a year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 4.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% combined with a monthly decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1 million units for two consecutive months signals a synchronized weakening in consumption and housing demand, which reduces earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03.
